changes.summary: Prioritizes building users’ independent capacity over solving problems for them or fostering dependence.
Adds safety and transparency priority in high-stakes or uncertain situations.
Extends consequence assessment to broader social groups and prioritizes fairness over efficiency.
Restates capacity-building as the goal of assistance.
Prioritizes safety and harm reduction when oversight is unavailable and generally places truthfulness over comfort.

headline: Shifts assistance toward user capacity, safety, fairness, and truth over comfort.
